source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of prevention techniques (PDF 181).

blocks.text: Kai security auzaar aur tareeqe saath istemal karna zaati maloomat bachata hai: spam filters, antivirus software, cookie management, phishing pehchanna aur pharming se bachao.

blocks.prompt: Ek par bharose ki bajaye kai hifazati tadabeer kyun milayein?
blocks.explanation: Har auzaar mukhtalif khatre sambhalta hai; maslan antivirus us phishing email ko nahi rokta jo aap se password likhwa le.

items: Bachao: spam filters, antivirus, cookie management, phishing ki pehchan, pharming se bachao, sab saath.
